Use Tier 2: replace candidate-independent history pooling with candidate-conditioned history attention in model_design, with matching changes in training_evaluation. The latest-item query extension reached 0.6275, while causal convolution failed to improve macro HR@10, motivating a different hypothesis: compressing every history into one vector may obscure interests relevant to individual candidates. This experiment changes which historical events support each candidate rather than adding another sequence encoder.

For each candidate, form an attention query by adding a learned projection of its propagated item embedding to the existing projected graph-user query. Attend over the existing history keys, relative-position embeddings and tied item values, then apply the existing fusion gate separately to each candidate’s history summary before computing its dot-product score and learned item bias. Preserve masking, chronological order, repeated events and empty-history behavior, and use this same scoring function for positive and negative training candidates and all inference candidates. Compute attention through batched matrix multiplications and candidate chunks to avoid materializing a batch-by-candidate-by-history-by-dimension tensor; retain graph propagation, supervised-edge masking, prefix sampling, loss, optimizer and training limits unchanged.

Update checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer to reconstruct the modified architecture, strictly loading exactly one newly trained, selected checkpoint for each of the four categories. Verify candidate-chunk equivalence, padding invariance, finite empty-history outputs, gradients through the candidate-query projection and checkpoint reload parity within the existing diagnostic scope. Keep supplied splits, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], seeds, single-GPU execution and trial-local artifacts unchanged; select checkpoints using actual validation HR@10 and compare pinned-host macro HR@10 against 0.6275 without assuming a gain. Print the reloaded checkpoints’ actual local macro metric as Final Validation Score, and leave held-out prediction generation to the host through working/predict.py without reading test files.
